title: Law of Total Probability & Total Expectation
interviewAnswer: Condition on useful groups, solve within each group, then average using group probabilities. These identities are powerful for mixture distributions, debugging aggregate metrics and Bayesian reasoning.
why: Law of Total Probability & Total Expectation is a recurring foundation across data science and machine learning because it affects both theoretical correctness and practical system behavior.
deepDive: Condition on useful groups, solve within each group, then average using group probabilities. These identities are powerful for mixture distributions, debugging aggregate metrics and Bayesian reasoning. E[X]=E[E[X|Y]]. Stratification can explain aggregate differences. The interview-level skill is not merely recalling the definition: explain the assumptions, what diagnostic evidence you would inspect, and what alternative you would choose when those assumptions fail.
workedExample: Overall conversion is a weighted average of device-specific conversion rates.
commonMistakes: Using the concept mechanically without checking assumptions or data semantics.
Reporting one metric/result without examining uncertainty, slices or failure modes.
followUps: What assumptions or limitations does Law of Total Probability & Total Expectation have?

production: In production, make assumptions explicit, validate on representative slices, compare with a simple baseline and monitor the signals that can drift.
